pages.text: $(bold)Where traits come from$(reset): the Life Breeder grafts traits onto "fixed, non-native" organs — 1 same-source gene sequence + 2 exhausted crystals + 60,000 life energy, 1000 ticks (50s).$(br2)$(bold)Unlock tiers follow sequence purity:$(reset)$(li)purity <60: tier 1 only$(li)60-84: tiers 1-2$(li)85+: tiers 1-3 unlocked$(br2)Each roll is benign : dual ≈ $(reset)7:3$(reset); this entry lists all $(reset)45 benign traits$(reset) — about half carry a $(reset)[slot-only]$(reset) tag: their effect is bound to an organ slot (eye/lungs/legs/arms/guts/kidneys/heart) and only appears on that slot's organs; the rest fit any slot.$(br)Each entry is tagged by direction: $(reset)Strike$(reset) = offensive pressure, $(reset)Ward$(reset) = defense/survival, $(reset)Glide$(reset) = mobility, senses & convenience. Traits are spread over one page per tier for readability.

pages.title: Tier 1 · Benign (10)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike$(reset)$(li)Muscle Fiber: +1 attack$(li)Reflex Neurons: +0.4 attack speed$(br2)$(bold)Ward$(reset)$(li)Dense Tissue: +1 armor$(li)Hyperactive Marrow: +3 max health$(li)Vascular Mesh: +1 armor toughness$(li)Dense Bone: +0.1 knockback resist$(li)Ossified Ligament: +0.5 armor, +0.05 knockback resist$(li)Keratin Layer: +0.5 armor, +0.5 armor toughness$(br2)$(bold)Glide$(reset)$(li)Elastic Tendon: +1.5% move speed$(li)Coordination Neurons: +1 luck$(br2)Tier 1 provides small clean gains — no downsides, clear stacking, a suitable foundation.

pages.title: Tier 2 · Benign (1/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike$(reset)$(li)Venom Gland: poison II on hit (3s) [guts]$(li)Power Cord: +1 attack, +0.2 attack speed [arms]$(li)Scorch Gland: ignites target on hit (3s)$(li)Eagle Membrane: +25% projectile damage [eyes]$(li)Hormone Recycler: +0.2 attack speed [kidneys]$(br2)$(bold)Ward (I)$(reset)$(li)Carapace Growth: +2 armor, +0.2 knockback resist$(li)Lymph Filter: purges own poison every 5s [kidneys]$(li)Arctic Cells: freeze immune, clears slowness$(li)Cushion Sole: immune to fall damage [legs]

pages.title: Tier 2 · Benign (2/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Ward (II)$(reset)$(li)Omnivore Gut: eating restores health [guts]$(li)Alchemist Gut: periodically drinks a random buff potion [guts]$(li)Myocardium: +2 max health [heart]$(br2)$(bold)Glide$(reset)$(li)Night-Vision Retina: constant night vision [eyes]$(li)Gill Slits: water breathing [lungs]$(li)Bioluminescent Cells: self glow$(li)Sticky Glands: slow II on hit (5s)$(li)Glider Membrane: slow-fall glide [lungs]$(li)Abyssal Webbing: greatly faster swimming [lungs]$(li)Symbiote Flora: +1 luck [guts]$(br2)Tier 2 begins adding $(reset)passives$(reset) — ignite, ranged, aquatic and sustain appear here; items tagged $(reset)[slot]$(reset) only appear on that slot's organs.

pages.title: Tier 3 · Benign (1/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike$(reset)$(li)Wither Tooth: wither II on hit (3s)$(li)Catapult Muscle: +60% jump-attack damage$(li)Charge Muscle: shoves the target back on hit$(li)Depth Pressure: +50% underwater attack damage$(li)Elongated Joints: +0.75 block attack reach$(li)Lassitude Gland: mining-fatigue on hit (counters griefers)$(br2)$(bold)Ward (I)$(reset)$(li)Crystal Carapace: +1.5 armor, reflects 30% melee$(li)Stem Cell Regeneration: constant slow regen$(li)Refractory Cells: fire/lava immune

pages.title: Tier 3 · Benign (2/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Ward (II)$(reset)$(li)Pressure Skin: −30% explosion damage taken$(li)Synovial Lining: immune to slowness & cobweb stick$(br2)$(bold)Glide$(reset)$(li)Shadow Vein: blink dodge when hit$(li)Jump Tendons: +1% move + jump boost$(li)Alert Retina: +0.5 armor, highlights hostiles$(li)Streamline Cartilage: +2% move$(li)Magnet Down: auto-picks up nearby drops$(br2)Tier 3 is the benign ceiling — attack reach, underwater damage, slow immunity and knockback-on-hit live here; anything stronger usually demands a dual-edge price — see the Dual-Edge catalog.

Benign and dual traits roll from the same pool; compare on the Dual-Edge page. Unlock depends on sequence purity — see Samples & Sequences for where purity comes from. For rerolling tools read The Secrets of Life.
